question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Make no bones about something

options.text: Insist on buying only boneless mutton
Be frank and open about something
Be fussy about bones in one's soup

solution:
The correct answer is "**Be frank and open about something** "

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the **given idiom:**
 
• **Make no bones about something: ** means **to say clearly what you think or feel about something, however unpleasant or awkward it is**.(स्पष्ट रूप से कहने के लिए कि आप किसी चीज़ के बारे में क्या सोचते हैं या महसूस करते हैं, चाहे वह कितना भी अप्रिय या अजीब क्यों न हो)
 
 
• **Example: ***Some of them **make no bones about** their political views*.** * ***
 
• * ****Make no bones about** **it***. ***We are going to win. *
 
 
 
• ​From the above lines, we can say that '**Be frank and open about something'** is the correct meaning of the given idiom.
 
• The correct answer is **option 2.**
